messages:
maya: Quick idea: prototype "delta-buckets" for cache-savings attribution — split savings into fixed windows (eg 1h) instead of attaching all future-token saves to the originating session. Aims: stabler per-tenant previews in console, fewer invoice surprises.

ben: TL;DR?

maya: Current hurts when long multi-step sessions inflate a single tenant's amortized saves. Delta-buckets: record per-SKU deltas per window. Console shows windowed preview + diffs.

ryan: Shared cache across tenants -> double-counting?

maya: Use deterministic partition_key = hash(invocation_id)%N to assign ownership idempotently. If cross-tenant hits exceed threshold, prorate using sampled hit-likelihoods.

sophia: Sampling for billing is risky. Error bounds?

maya: Prototype uses 5% sampling with bootstrap CIs; low-volume SKUs default to conservative upward rounding. We surface CI to console.

samir: Internal API for ops/console? tests?

maya: Draft minimal API shape: POST /internal/econ/credits/apply { tenant_id, window_start, window_end, strategy:"delta-buckets-v1", entries:[{sku, tokens_saved, partition_key, route_id}] } — no per-invocation blobs.

ben: Console UX requests: preview toggle, 24h diff slider, "estimate" badge if confidence low, link to docs. Also enterprise opt-out flag recommended.

sophia: Add control_plane.disable_delta_buckets tenant flag for legal requests.

ryan: Infra concerns: 1) proration needs cross-tenant hit matrices 2) sampling skew on distribution shifts.

maya: Mitigations: only compute proration when shared-hit rate > 0.5% in window; rolling bootstrap + confidence score; fallback to conservative attribution if CI < 0.7.

samir: Routing/quotas interaction: credits must include route_id + sku to avoid subsidizing bad routing. Router must emit route affinity with invocations.

opsbot: Deploy checklist: run sim over 14d traces, add CI test for low-volume skew, console feature flag, gate for enterprise opt-out.

ben: Next actions: maya -> API proto + docs; ryan -> infra cost estimate; sophia -> UX copy; samir -> tests. Sync Friday? :calendar:
